### Sources

The daily source program screened five fanfiction-oriented candidate families: FanFiction.Net, Fimfiction, Scribble Hub's Fanfiction catalog, Archive of Our Own (AO3), and Twisting the Hellmouth. FanFiction.Net, Fimfiction, and Scribble Hub received complete source-specific review for the capability actually admitted and shipped through pull request #116 as a new `Fanfiction Discovery Starter`.

The admitted capability is deliberately static link-only. FanFiction.Net's public search surface is usable for ordinary reader discovery, while its current public terms and crawler policy do not justify a WebNR crawler or mirror. Fimfiction exposes a public Stories browser and an official API, but its API terms require responsible resource use, rate-limit compliance, caching, and avoidance of replicating core site functionality; this integration does not call that API or use credentials. Scribble Hub exposes a public Fanfiction genre/Series Finder, while its user-content relationship does not grant WebNR a general redistribution license. WebNR therefore stores only the three first-party destination URLs plus WebNR-authored labels/descriptions and copies no story metadata, covers, ratings, comments, account state, downloads, or story text.

AO3 remains a high-value candidate for the scheduled 2026-08-26 ecosystem guide, but this cycle did not obtain sufficiently current first-party machine-access/policy evidence to admit a source capability safely. Twisting the Hellmouth was also screened, but its first-party reader surface was not reliably accessible from the operating environment. Both remain deferred rather than being treated as failed, licensed, or safe for ingestion by assumption.

Rotating health review rechecked three already maintained discovery surfaces: SpaceBattles Discover Stories, Sufficient Velocity Story Library, and Top Web Fiction. Their public discovery surfaces remained available in the bounded review. The daily target of screening at least five candidates, fully auditing at least three, shipping at least one passing integration, and rotating existing-source health was satisfied.
